decision: Archive both variants; serving route unchanged

diagnostic_runtime_manifest.method: server-only ctypes.CDLL Objective-C runtime method replacement, native Metal GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime, actual MTLFunction.name
diagnostic_runtime_manifest.compiler:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.4.1.1)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin27.0.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin

limits: Native intervals overlap; mixed kernel groups kept intact. No exclusive GPU-percentage claim.
Primitive-isolated diagnostic scheduling is not the unchanged serving policy.
Q8/Q4 timing uses real captured inputs and normal buffer policy, 12 interleaved rounds per operation.

Q8 replay predates dedicated replay swap sampling; vm_stat after replay showed Swapouts13202274, same host counter as the surrounding successful capture. Q4 replay explicitly sampled the 1GiB cumulative guard with zero writes.
No candidate whole-model TTFT or cache/rollback/continuation qualification was run because no candidate was retained.
Captured tensors, private keys, native binaries and GPU capture bundles are deliberately excluded.
